source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 1986 official canvass
source_notes: 1986 regular Arizona gubernatorial election. County and statewide cells transcribed from page 2 of the official canvass issued by the Arizona Secretary of State (1986-11-24); every candidate's county cells sum to the printed statewide TOTAL, and the statewide totals also match Wikipedia's results table (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1986_Arizona_gubernatorial_election). Every cell was first transcribed from RightDataUSA's county page and then checked against the canvass with no differences. Election-wide registration and turnout are the official figures already imported with the same election's Senate canvass. The canvass PDF was supplied by the project maintainer and is retained with its SHA-256.
